name: 公園
description: A sunny city park. A red bench stands under a big tree. A dog is running near a fountain, two children are playing with a ball, and an old man is reading a newspaper on the bench.

name: 台所
description: A small kitchen in the evening. A pot of soup is boiling on the stove, vegetables are on a cutting board, a cat is sleeping on a chair, and the window shows the sunset.

name: 駅のホーム
description: A crowded train station platform in the morning. A blue train is arriving, people are waiting in line, a man is looking at his phone, a clock shows eight o'clock, and a vending machine stands by the wall.
